entities.summary: Vladimir Yevgenevich Ivanovsky was a Russian diplomat. He last served as the Russian Ambassador to Turkey (2007–2013). He had previously served as the Russian Ambassador to Macedonia (2000–2002) and Serbia and Montenegro (2002–2004).
